prompt_en: Create a complex photorealistic scene of one unmistakably adult East Asian woman, visually informed by the supplied portrait. She conducts a coral-health survey in an after-hours bioluminescent aquarium research gallery, pressing a fluorescence scanner to a marked viewing pane and recording a tagged coral colony on a waterproof slate. A slightly elevated, near-frontal medium portrait keeps her face unobscured and her entire hair arrangement clearly readable from roots through outer silhouette to all visible ends. Her cornrow scalp braids are explicit: multiple narrow braided ridges cover the scalp in a dense readable array; each row remains attached closely along the scalp from its visible origin onward; clean scalp parting lanes separate adjacent rows across the crown and both sides; the braided ridges follow continuous deliberate row paths from hairline toward back and sides; two large Dutch braids and free box braids do not substitute for this fine scalp-woven topology. A soft neutral survey lamp reveals facial and scalp detail while cyan and emerald coral fluorescence reflects through the glass onto the scanner, calibration target, and specimen tags.
